title: AION 2 Ranger: Leveling Build and Skills
description: Start an AION 2 Ranger with MP-aware leveling choices, a Snipe and Deadshot example, and Daevanion priorities that account for Global and Taiwan differences.
summary: Keep ranged attacks sustainable, select the specializations you unlock, and upgrade the skills your current build actually uses.
quickAnswer: Start with MP recovery on your ordinary attack, reliable ranged attacks and reachable movement or control skills. The demonstrated Snipe–Deadshot cooldown interaction needs an unlocked option; select it explicitly rather than expecting the later build’s repetition on a fresh character.
